checks.name: approved verify-coaching-panel.mjs
checks.detail:
PASS Off starts without a suggestion or charge
PASS Toggle, gallery navigation and automatic events do not consume a session
PASS An explicit suggestion uses one session
PASS Why, seek and feedback share that session and preserve the live phase
PASS The second request uses the remaining free session; an extra request locks
PASS Related selection comments update the authorized session without another charge
PASS Turning off prevents automatic comments and closes replay without changing balance
PASS Confirmation retires a pending selection note while off and does not charge
PASS Default timing retires a confirmed Trix double note immediately
PASS A played card archives the prior live cue even in When I ask mode
PASS Off/on shows the latest selected cards without spending another session
PASS Allowance and off preference survive reload
PASS New game resets the session without refunding the allowance
PASS Demo Unlock permits repeated explicit requests without charging
PASS Portrait hides the panel and pauses replay; landscape restores the same replay
PASS Local midnight restores two free uses; preview controls change only demo access
PASS Coach opens unpinned, including preferences saved before pinning existed
PASS Pin and unpin preserve the coaching session, replay, seek control and allowance
PASS Only a visible pinned panel reserves space; hiding preserves the preference
PASS Measured pin boundary preserves session and replay at 759/760/761px
PASS Narrow and portrait pin transitions restore the preference at zero quota
PASS Explicit pin preference survives reload, a new game and demo allowance changes
PASS Waiting sticker toggles the panel and stays available while open; X only closes
PASS Only Trix double, Spades bid and Hearts pass show a closed-window whistle
PASS Open and X acknowledge a decision; changing selected cards does not nag again
PASS Source phase transitions arm once before shell state updates and retain acknowledgment
PASS Exhausted allowance suppresses fresh-session attention; Demo Unlocked permits it
PASS Portrait, navigation and pause hide attention without spending or losing pin preference
PASS Sticker assets and accessible status are local, with no sound or card changes
PASS No footer nodes, coaching dialogs, network calls or iframe remounts

30 offline state/DOM contract groups passed. No browser/rendering assertions were run.
